label: Fix 3 bugs in blob-store/src/store.ts
summary: Three bugfixes applied to libs/data/store/blob-store/src/store.ts: verifyAll() concurrency pattern (Promise.race never-shrinking bug → proper batch-wait with Promise.allSettled), acquireGcLock() cross-process serialization (added exclusive file creation lock with 30s timeout), allocateTempPath() PRNG (Math.random → crypto.randomUUID).

type_based.notes: Data lib playbook: nx build → nx test → nx lint. No registry sync needed (data packages not in registry/index.json). No scope/host verification needed.

changes.kind: Bug 1: verifyAll() — replaced Promise.race + never-matching findIndex with Promise.allSettled batch-wait pattern; pending array now properly shrinks via splice(0, concurrency); drain loop uses same batch pattern instead of sequential await each.
Bug 2: acquireGcLock() — added cross-process GC serialization via exclusive file creation lock (fsp.open(path, 'wx') with retry + 30s timeout). Replaced no-op open-a-with-datasync pattern.
Bug 3: allocateTempPath() — replaced Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,8) with crypto.randomUUID().replace(/-/g,'').slice(0,8). Added randomUUID import from node:crypto.

issues: NODE: flock() from node:fs is not available in this Node.js runtime (v24.11.1 on macOS). The spec called for flock(fd, LOCK_EX), but fs.flock and fs.constants.LOCK_EX/LOCK_UN are absent. Fixed by using exclusive file creation (fsp.open(path, 'wx') with O_EXCL semantics) which provides equivalent cross-process serialization.
handoff_notes: The acquireGcLock() implementation uses exclusive file create (.lock.acquire) instead of flock() because the runtime lacks it. Compatible interface: returns { close } where close() releases the lock (closes fd + unlinks .lock.acquire).
verifyAll() now batches via pending.splice(0, concurrency) + Promise.allSettled. Rejected promises are silently dropped (no reject handling in the original code either — the spec didn't add any).
